title: My Sites with more rows than the tab is high scrolls inside the tab down to its last site
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-timeout=60000 packages/site/tracy-my-sites/test/e2e/table-fits-panel.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the test named for the scroll to the last row.
expect: Inside a fixed-height host with overflow hidden (like dsh's tab body), the list root is exactly as high as the host and does not overflow it.
The table box scrolls; after scrolling to the end the last row is fully visible below the column headers.
The column header cells stay at the top of the table box and have an opaque background.
evidence: On cowork.tracy.site (09/10/2026) the tab body was 903px with overflow hidden and the list 1457px with 30 rows: every row below the tab's bottom edge was clipped and the account's real site (tracy.ai, the oldest) could not be reached.
fence: The list root fills the tab height and the table box is the only vertical scroller

tests: with more rows than the tab is high, the table box scrolls to the last row under sticky headers
